# Submission Integrity & Security Checklist: Agentic Advent of Code Solver

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the two highest-risk areas — real answer submission
(including recovery) and isolation/secret handling — before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Generation context: no interactive answers were available (operator asked the agent to proceed
autonomously), so the command's documented defaults were applied — depth **Standard**, audience
**Reviewer (PR)**, focus = top 2 relevance clusters: *submission integrity & recovery* and
*isolation & secrets*.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all website response categories that affect progression enumerated with the action required for each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the behaviour defined for the window between persisting an intended submission and receiving its response (crash, network loss)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what happens when the account session expires mid-run? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the scope of the rejected-answer ledger defined (per run vs. across runs for the same account)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements specified for how manual-approval mode interacts with cooldowns and pause/stop? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the categories of data that must never reach the sandbox, prompts, client, logs and events listed exhaustively? [Completeness, Spec §FR-042]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "reconcile against the day's completion state" defined precisely enough to decide accepted vs. not accepted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "too high/too low bounds" usage defined for non-numeric answers? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "previously completed" distinguished from "verified in this run" with explicit criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "isolated remote sandbox" quantified with concrete limits (CPU, memory, output size)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "descriptive identification string with contact information" specified (format, where contact comes from)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are the attempt limit (FR-004 default 6) and the submission limit (default 3) consistent with the escalation threshold (default 3) so escalation can occur before failure? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK013 Do cooldown rules (FR-020) and "continue with next day after FAILED" (FR-016) agree when a part fails while a cooldown is active? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the Day 25 claim rule consistent between Clarifications, Edge Cases and FR-022? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-003 (zero identical resubmissions, zero early submissions) be measured from persisted data alone? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-009 (no secret in any log/event/payload/file) backed by a defined set of secret values to scan for? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK017 Does SC-001 define how acceptance evidence is captured for a live demo? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are exception flows defined for an unexpected (unclassifiable) submission response? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK019 Are recovery requirements defined for a restart while waiting for a cooldown? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for generated code that attempts network, file or environment access? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the behaviour defined when the website redirects to an unexpected host? [Coverage, Spec §FR-041]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Is the network exposure of the operator's local application specified (who may call the API that triggers submissions)? [Gap, Security, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 Are prompt-injection risks from puzzle content addressed beyond "kept separate from system instructions"? [Coverage, Security, Spec §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK024 Are retention/deletion requirements defined for cached private inputs and recorded runs? [Gap, Privacy, Spec §FR-044]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the assumption that cooldowns apply account-wide (not per part) validated or marked as an assumption to verify? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the dependency on the website's response wording documented as a fragility with a fallback (UNEXPECTED → stop and reconcile)? [Dependency, Spec §FR-017]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Several items (CHK004, CHK008, CHK019, CHK022, CHK024) are answered in `plan.md`/`data-model.md`
  but not in `spec.md`; the reviewer should decide whether the spec needs amending.
